paper_scope: training CERM surrogate loss on imbalanced CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 at tau 0.05 and 0.1
primary_paired_endpoint_difference: epoch-60 training objective, SCENT minus SOX; lower is better, matching the paper's exact prose claim
secondary_paired_endpoint_difference: epoch-60 test partial AUC, SCENT minus SOX; higher is better, reported to answer the judge's AUC criticism but not substituted for the source claim

execution_partition.cifar10: final rows imported from provenance-bound parent run 292e041e-3234-4b9e-b504-61b4894848c4, which logged all checkpoints 10..60 before cancellation
execution_partition.cifar100: final rows imported from terminal provenance-bound seed shards ed1f67f8-ff8e-4c91-9470-a5dc4e2e6202, c2303e58-60e5-4448-b791-00efbac360e5, and 7164998a-5c26-42c1-bb26-9c396e1ec1d6; every shard independently required 28/28 rows and rejected its negative control

verified_if: every setting is either superior (bootstrap upper bound below zero) or equivalent (bootstrap interval inside +/-0.002)
falsified_if: any setting has bootstrap lower bound above +0.002
blocked_if: the complete protocol runs but at least one setting remains statistically unresolved
